fields.name: steps

fields.name: cfg
fields.label: CFG
fields.tooltip: Structure-stage guidance. 7.5 is the official template calibration (2026-09-06: the 3.0 default sampled the coarse shape at under half guidance — blobby trash out of the box). Lower runs looser.

fields.name: bg_removal
fields.label: Background removal
fields.tooltip: auto/on: birefnet cuts the background (recommended). off: feed a pre-cleaned or alpha-cut image straight to conditioning.
